title: inferenceproxy's migration proof moves the home on Windows too: its scratch HOME is USERPROFILE as well
intention: A proof of this component that moves the home in-process moves it on every box: Path.home() is the scratch on Windows too.
why: Measured 2026-11-13 on akienyoga9i (Windows) via bin/cairn test at house HEAD: test_gone_with_a_dump_answers_the_counts_and_sums reds with dump_spent/dump_avoided/dump_newest None. _home sets HOME in-process with monkeypatch.setenv, and on Windows Path.home() reads USERPROFILE, so the device's dump lookup reads the live ~/.cairn/devices/inferenceproxy/0/temp, not the scratch. scratch_home_bypass reads [] here: it sees child envs, not an in-process set. Green on Linux.
traces_to: Law 3; Law 8 (a proof that reads the live home measures the box, not the code).
how: D1: _home also does monkeypatch.setenv('USERPROFILE', str(home)). D2: new tooth test_the_scratch_home_is_the_home_on_every_box: after _home, HOME and USERPROFILE both name the scratch and Path.home() equals it. Its USERPROFILE assertion reds on Linux too, so a hollow of D1 reds on every box.
